mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kit_job_log_report ( trigger_day, running_count, suc_count, fail_count, update_time ) VALUES ( #{triggerDay}, #{runningCount}, #{sucCount}, #{failCount}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE running_count = #{runningCount}, suc_count = #{sucCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, update_time = #{updateTime}

INSERT INTO kit_job_log_report ( trigger_day, running_count, suc_count, fail_count, update_time ) VALUES ( #{triggerDay}, #{runningCount}, #{sucCount}, #{failCount}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (i_trigger_day) DO UPDATE SET running_count = #{runningCount}, suc_count = #{sucCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, update_time = #{updateTime}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(running_count) AS running_count, SUM(suc_count) AS suc_count, SUM(fail_count) AS fail_count FROM kit_job_log_report AS t
